opening.argument: This is a demonstration of a PancakeSwap sniping bot using a token created specifically for testing, with the speaker adding 0.01 BNB of personal liquidity and observing the resulting liquidity and buy transactions. The stated workflow is that the bot detects pending liquidity activity and sends a buy order, while the speaker invites viewers to contact him to purchase the software. Claims that it can overcome anti-bot measures or complete buying, approval and selling in the same block remain presented as the seller's assertions. Nothing observed shows deceptive access to viewer funds or a promised investment payout; the evidence instead supports an ordinary commercial software demonstration.

citations.quote: I created this Lambo token for test purpose.
Now I'm going to add liquidity of 0.01 BNB.
Bot detected the liquidity add event and buy order is send.
You can find my contact details in the description if you'd like to purchase, or have any questions.
Unlike other bots in the market, this bot can buy, approve and sell the token in the. Same block where liquidity is added.
